senses.gloss: prefix (comp. of <cite ref="B00000"><he>בְּ</he></cite> a. <he>דְּ</he> = h. <he>בְּשֶׁ־</he>, <cite ref="B01360"><he>בְּשֶׁל</he></cite>)
concerning that (those) of; at the time of; treating of what refers to.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 112a:6">Sabb. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>בדטייעי</he> in the case of those (sandals) of the travelling merchants (Arabs).
<cite ref="Chullin 20a:1">Ḥull. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>ומתני׳ בדלא אהדר</he> our Mishnah treats of a case when he did not turn.
<cite ref="Gittin 49a:1">Gitt. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>בדניזק וכ׳</he> we go in our assessment by (the property) of the injured; a. v. fr.
Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 5 בִּדְּלֵית unless.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 9:4">Targ. O. Deut. IX, 4</cite> <he>בִּדְּיִתְּבַר</he>; a. e.
